purpose: Schema for a per-project policy entry in infra/external-projects.json. Defines the minimum fields required to govern an external (non-CYNIC) project through CYNIC's agentic OS ports.

language_stack.description: Observed primary language stack (e.g. go, typescript/node, go+csharp).

ports_used.description: CYNIC port names this project actually consumes/produces. Empty until wired and observed.

cadence.description: How often dependency drift is reported (e.g. monthly).

channel.description: How drift is observed (e.g. npm-outdated-report, cargo-outdated-report).

owner.description: collaborator_id responsible for applying bumps in the product repo.

bump_policy.description: report-only emits findings; human-applied means the owner bumps after review. Automated bumps are forbidden.

maintenance.description: Dependency maintenance subscription for this project. Observation only; CYNIC never bumps product deps itself.

rules: Default for a newly added project: mutation_policy=read_only, sensitivity=public.
aegis-core (sanitized) must never be deployed by CYNIC; read-only observation + build/test only.
ports_used must be empty until a port is wired and observed; aspirational entries are forbidden.
build/test commands must be observed on the builder before status=verified.
maintenance.bump_policy defaults to report-only; no automated dependency bumps without recorded human consent.
